verdict.rationale: Veriff advertises a 'No-code identity verification solution', and its Zapier integration lets teams automate downstream workflows on verification decisions without code. Both are only glancing support for configuring the verification logic itself. Nothing in the evidence shows an ops-facing flow builder in the Customer Portal. Missing for 10: no-code conditional step configuration, risk-based routing within the verification flow, country-specific document/requirement rules, template or flow changes without an engineering deploy, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
